title: Writing / Style / Capitalization
slide_intent: Assign capitalization by content role so approachability and recognizable interface labels can coexist.
strategic_value: Role-specific casing can help Duolingo keep most copy relaxed while making buttons and named content predictable.
demonstration: Five groups compare button, header, page/blog, video and story title capitalization.
practical_value: Choose case from the content’s role instead of applying sentence case or title case universally.

content_islands.name: Guidance column
content_islands.spec: Place the Capitalization heading, approachability rationale and cross-reference at left.

content_islands.name: Worked examples
content_islands.spec: Stack five rule-and-example groups at right: buttons, headers/subheads, blog/page titles, videos and stories.

reference_purposes.Intent: The explanation links restrained capitalization to an approachable product and brand.
reference_purposes.Application: Five comparisons show casing choices for distinct content types.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Buttons use all caps; headers, subheads, blog and page titles use sentence case; video and story titles use title case.

ingredient.name: Capitalization by role
ingredient.role: Signal the type of text without making every line formal.
ingredient.application: Use all caps for buttons, sentence case for headers/subheads/blog/page titles, and title case for video and story titles.
ingredient.scope: Historical official guidelines from the 2024–2025 archived snapshot; this records the displayed guidance, not current Duolingo product behavior. This is the displayed writing convention; typography-specific display-font rules elsewhere may add context.
